seo.title: Industrial Rope Access Services: Inspection & Rescue | RAC
seo.description: RAC rope access services: glass cleaning & façades, maintenance and repair at height, inspection & NDT, standby rescue, and Kemnaker-certified technicians.

hero.title: Work at Height, Done Properly
hero.body: Glass cleaning, façade care, repairs, inspection, and rescue at height — no scaffolding, no gondola, delivered by Kemnaker-certified technicians.

sections.title: Industrial rope access services
sections.intro: Every job begins with a written risk assessment and a rescue plan approved by the supervisor — before anyone touches a rope.

sections.title: Renovation, design, or construction?
sections.text: Talk to Inland, the architecture, construction, and building maintenance company in the same group as RAC.

sections.title: Request a written quotation
sections.text: Send the location, asset type, and target dates. We usually send an initial risk assessment and quotation the same working day.
